How a duel works

Four steps from your wallet to the pot

Sign in with Phantom

You sign one message to prove the wallet is yours. It never moves funds or costs a fee.

Pick your Monstar

Your wallet gets its own version of all nine species, with stats and looks no one else has.

Stake and share a code

Create a match, send the six-letter code to your rival. You both approve the same deposit in Phantom.

Fight for the pot

Every hit moves lamports to you live. KO your rival and one transaction pays you the whole pot.

The money

Measured in lamports, the smallest unit of SOL

One lamport is 0.000000001 SOL. Each hit moves at least one, and you see your share change the moment it lands.

Your stake0.010000 SOL
Rival's stake0.010000 SOL
Pot0.020000 SOL
Hit for 10% of rival HP+0.001000 SOL
Company fee per match1 lamport
Network fee (paid from pot)0.000005 SOL
Winner receives0.019994999 SOL
Hit fee
stake × damage ÷ rival max HP

Taken from the victim's share, added to the attacker's. Shares always add up to the pot.

KO: winner takes the whole pot. Time up: higher HP takes it. Exact tie: each keeps their share.

The game server runs the fight, so hits can't be faked. Your Phantom balance updates a few seconds after the KO, when the single payout transaction confirms.

Nine species · nine classes

No two Monstars are ever the same

Your Monstars' DNA comes from your wallet address. It sets rarity, aura, pattern, nature, color and six stats, and the registry refuses any repeat.

Wild Expedition · 54 to catch

Fifty wild Monstars, three angels and a god

Pay 0.0001 SOL to enter the wild. Beat a wild Monstar for a chance to catch it. Rarer ones are stronger and harder to catch, and everything you catch hatches as an Infant. You can also battle 3v3 in the Arena.

Playing on a phone

Open the game inside Phantom

Phone browsers can't talk to your wallet. Phantom's built-in browser can, so the Play button sends you there.

Play in Phantom
  1. 1Install Phantom from the App Store or Google Play and create or import a wallet.
  2. 2For devnet testing: Settings → Developer Settings → turn on Testnet Mode and pick Solana Devnet. Get free test SOL from faucet.solana.com.
  3. 3Tap Play in Phantom on this page. The game opens in Phantom's browser.
  4. 4Go to 1v1 Stake, tap Connect Phantom & sign in, then create a match or join with your rival's code.
Questions

Before you stake

Is this real money?

Not yet. PocketMonstars runs on Solana devnet, where SOL is free test currency with no value. Real-money stakes come later, after an independent security review and legal review.

Why doesn't my Phantom balance change on every hit?

Each Solana transaction costs at least 5,000 lamports and needs a wallet approval. Sending one per hit would cost more than the hit is worth and interrupt the fight. The game tracks your live share of the escrowed pot, then pays it out in one transaction at the end.

What's the minimum stake?

0.001 SOL. Solana needs a new account to hold about 0.00089 SOL, and each match uses its own escrow account. Free matches with no stake are also available.

What happens if my rival leaves?

If they disconnect for 15 seconds during a duel, you win the pot. If a match never starts, deposits are refunded minus the 0.000005 SOL network fee, with no company fee.

How does evolving work?

Every Monstar hatches as an Infant. Landing hits earns EXP, and it evolves at level 3 (Rookie), 10 (Champion), 25 (Ultimate), 50 (Mega) and 80 (Ascended). Its stats grow every level, and it can evolve in the middle of a match.

Can I leave a staked match early?

No. SOL moves to the winner when the match ends. If you leave or disconnect for 15 seconds, it counts as a loss and your rival takes the pot.

Can someone copy my Monstar?

No. Each Monstar's DNA and visible traits are unique in the registry, and only registry Monstars can be minted into the official collection.
